titulo_es: Write a short message with place and time

Vi ses på lördag istället.es: Nos vemos el sábado en su lugar

texto: Invite, accept or reject with courtesy and propose another moment. **Vi ses på lördag istället** means «See you Saturday instead.». Read the expression as a unit, identify the main word and use it in a daily situation. If your device has a Swedish voice, listen to the example and repeat it. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
